description: Accept/Reject Invite System with follow-based auto-accept. Backend changes to CreateDmChatRoomService to check if invited participant follows the room creator - if yes, auto-accept; otherwise set accepted: false. Frontend changes to show pending invites with accept/reject UI.
steps: 1. Backend - app/services/create_dm_chat_room_service.rb: In the create_room method, change participant creation logic. For each participant, check if Follow.exists?(account: participant, target_account: owner). If the participant follows the owner, set accepted: true, joined_at: Time.current. Otherwise set accepted: false, joined_at: nil.
2. Backend - app/workers/migrate_conversations_to_dm_worker.rb: Verify that the create_room method already sets accepted: true for migrated rooms (it does - no changes needed, just confirm).

3. Backend - app/serializers/rest/dm_chat_room_serializer.rb: Add an 'accepted' attribute that returns the current user's membership accepted status. Method: def accepted; membership = object.dm_chat_room_accounts.find_by(account: current_account); membership&.accepted end. Add :accepted to the attributes list.
4. Frontend types - app/javascript/mastodon/api_types/dm.ts: Add 'accepted: boolean' to ApiDmChatRoomJSON interface.
5. Frontend reducer - app/javascript/mastodon/reducers/dm.ts: Add 'accepted: boolean' to DmChatRoom interface. Update normalizeChatRoom to include accepted field from the API response.

6. Frontend actions - app/javascript/mastodon/actions/dm.ts: Add DM_CHAT_ROOM_ACCEPTED constant. Add acceptChatRoom thunk that calls apiAcceptDmChatRoom(uuid), dispatches DM_CHAT_ROOM_UPDATED with the response. Add rejectChatRoom thunk that calls apiDeleteDmChatRoom(uuid), dispatches DM_CHAT_ROOM_LEFT.
7. Frontend reducer - app/javascript/mastodon/reducers/dm.ts: Handle DM_CHAT_ROOM_ACCEPTED if needed (DM_CHAT_ROOM_UPDATED already handles it since accept returns the updated room).

8. Frontend - app/javascript/mastodon/features/dm/components/chat_room_item.tsx: If room.accepted === false, show a visual indicator (e.g., a badge/label saying 'Conversation request' or different styling).

9. Frontend - app/javascript/mastodon/features/dm/components/chat_room_view.tsx: If room.accepted === false, instead of showing MessageCompose at the bottom, show an accept/reject bar with two buttons. Accept calls acceptChatRoom(roomId), reject calls rejectChatRoom(roomId) then navigates to /conversations.

10. Add translations - en.json: 'dm.invite.accept' = 'Accept', 'dm.invite.reject' = 'Decline', 'dm.invite.pending' = 'Conversation request', 'dm.invite.description' = '{name} wants to start a conversation'. ko.json: '수락', '거절', '대화 요청', '{name}님이 대화를 요청했습니다'.
11. Styles - app/javascript/styles/mastodon/dm.scss: Add styles for the invite bar (accept/reject buttons, pending badge on chat room items).
acceptance_criteria: CreateDmChatRoomService checks Follow relationship and sets accepted accordingly
Serializer returns 'accepted' field for current user's membership
Chat room list shows pending indicator for unaccepted rooms
Chat room view shows accept/reject buttons instead of compose when not accepted
Accepting updates the room state to accepted: true
Rejecting removes the room from the list (same as leave)
Migrated rooms always have accepted: true (already the case)
verification: Verify en.json and ko.json have all new translations
findings: All changes verified: Ruby syntax OK for both backend files, TypeScript compiles cleanly. Backend create_room method now checks Follow.exists? for auto-accept. Serializer returns accepted field. Frontend types/reducer/actions all updated. Chat room item shows pending badge. Chat room view shows accept/reject bar instead of compose when not accepted. Updated apiAcceptDmChatRoom to include ApiDmChatRoomJSON return type generic for better type safety.
